name: Weatherly 201 Ag Plane
summary: 1960s California single-seat ag plane powered by a 450 hp R-985 radial. All-metal cantilever low wing with six degrees of dihedral and a tailwheel.

wings: Low cantilever wing with no struts
engines: Single Pratt & Whitney R-985 radial in a round cowl
fuselage: Hopper ahead of a single-seat cockpit set high and aft

tellTales: Single-seat crop duster with a radial nose and a strut-free low wing
Hopper in front of a high, aft cockpit
Tailwheel gear under an all-metal airframe

confusedWith.howToTell: The 620 is the larger later version with a longer wing and bigger hopper; the 201 is smaller and earlier.
The Thrush is usually larger with a bigger radial or turbine nose; the Weatherly is a smaller R-985 airplane.
The PA-36 has a flat piston engine in a slimmer cowl; the Weatherly 201 has a big round radial cowl.
The Air Tractor is bigger and heavier with a taller cockpit; the Weatherly 201 is a smaller radial airplane.
